param: α₁ Recruitment rate into susceptible humans (A).
α₂ Recruitment/importation rate into infected humans (P).
ψ₁ Effective contact/transmission rate from infected humans (P) to susceptible humans (A).
ψ₂ Effective contact/transmission rate from environmental pathogens (U) to susceptible humans (A).
ψ₃ Effective contact/transmission rate from deceased humans (S) to susceptible humans (A) (e.g., burial contact).
ε Natural death rate of humans (applies to A, P, F, K).
ρ₁ Disease-induced death rate of infected humans (P).
ρ₂ Shedding rate of infected humans (P) into the environment (U).
ρ₃ Quarantine rate: infected humans (P) moved to quarantine (F).
ω₁ Recovery rate of quarantined humans (F) to recovered (K).
ω₂ Disease-induced death rate of quarantined humans (F) to deceased (S).
h Shedding rate of deceased humans (S) into the environment (U).
d External input/source term into environment (U) (e.g., bush meat contamination).
c Burial/removal rate of deceased humans (S).
Ω₁ Auxiliary quantity used in stability derivations (paper-defined).
Ω₂ Total removal rate from infected humans P.
Ω₃ Total removal rate from quarantined humans F.
Ω₄ Total removal rate from deceased humans S.
